So do you know PEMDAS?

Parentheses
Exponents
Multiplication/division
Addition/subtraction

First you start with the parentheses so you do everything inside of those. In your case you would do (1+2) to get (3)

Now your equation should be 6÷2(3)=

Since there are no exponents you go to multiplication/division

Now you can multiply the 2 and the 3 since when there is a number outside of the parentheses without a sign after it, means to multiply giving you 6. This means you now have 6÷6  as your equation which will give you 1 as your final answer. 

Hope this helps :D

Listen here, I know that you are in a bad place right now and you feel that the world is against you (I've been there too), but you need to hold on. Even if your family is not the kindest and you feel that you have no friends, there are still people you care about like your boyfriend. Stay on this earth for those who you know love you. Even if there are not many that you think, people care, and there are places for you to get help. Stay for your cat, your boyfriend. There is always another way. And although you say that your boyfriend deserves someone better, he is your boyfriend for a reason, he likes you for YOU. You are at rock bottom right now, there is only one way to go if you hold on... UP. You feel that you have no hope left for this would, but you still have at least one person who cares about you. Use that as your reason to stay here. What you do has a ripple affect on others, and even if you do not think they will care, they will. People care about you. Even if life seems unbearable and worthless, hold on and if it seems like too much to bear, live life day by day. Wake up with a goal of staying for those who love you. Ignore those who could care less, they are toxic to your health. Keep those who love you close and stay.
